messages.subject: Project Harbor - directors' duties note (privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert, Fiona, David,

Ahead of next week's board meeting, please find our note on directors' duties while the Group is in the zone of insolvency. The practical steps - regular minuted meetings, close cashflow monitoring, no preferences, reliance on the IBR - are on page 2. We'd suggest tabling it formally so the minutes record that the board considered it.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
